title: Lookup, a reading stand
label: Reading stand: a pillow-bevelled pane on four threaded posts over a long gridded frost plate; a gantry carriage carries a probe whose wire leans out through the bevel to a small read sled on a ticked track.
caption: A reading stand: a pane on threaded posts over the frost plate it reads from. In the flat middle the wire drops straight down; slide the probe toward the rim and the bevel bends the lookup outward, so the sled runs far along the track.
